# ‘Yojeong’ Raises Seed Funding to Transform Senior Care with AI-Powered Platform

1/8/2026

・

[이준희(John Lee)](https://en.wowtale.net/author/johnwowpartners-net/)

[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/facebook.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wowtale.net%2F2026%2F01%2F08%2F233275%2F "Sharing on Facebook")[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/twitter.svg)](https://twitter.com/share?url=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wowtale.net%2F2026%2F01%2F08%2F233275%2F&text=%E2%80%98Yojeong%E2%80%99+Raises+Seed+Funding+to+Transform+Senior+Care+with+AI-Powered+Platform "Sharing on twitter")![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/kakaotalk.svg)[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/line.svg)](https://line.me/R/msg/text/?%E2%80%98Yojeong%E2%80%99%20Raises%20Seed%20Funding%20to%20Transform%20Senior%20Care%20with%20AI-Powered%20Platform%0D%0Ahttps://en.wowtale.net/2026/01/08/233275/ "Sharing on Line")[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/band.svg)](https://www.band.us/plugin/share?body=%E2%80%98Yojeong%E2%80%99+Raises+Seed+Funding+to+Transform+Senior+Care+with+AI-Powered+Platform%20|%20https%3A%2F%2Fen.wowtale.net%2F2026%2F01%2F08%2F233275%2F "Sharing on Band")[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/mail.svg)](mailto:?subject=%E2%80%98Yojeong%E2%80%99%20Raises%20Seed%20Funding%20to%20Transform%20Senior%20Care%20with%20AI-Powered%20Platform&body=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wowtale.net%2F2026%2F01%2F08%2F233275%2F%0D%0A%0D%0A--%20Sent%20via%20PAVO%20SocialSharing "Sharing on Mail")[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/plugins/pavo-social-sharing/components/social-sharing/assets/icons/set6/clipboard.svg)](https://en.wowtale.net/2026/01/08/233275/#none "Save as Clipboard")

* * *

Yojeong(meaning of Essentials of Care), a data-driven senior tech startup in Korea, has secured [seed funding](http://en.wowtale.net/tag/seed) from [Seoul Techno Holdings](http://en.wowtale.net/tag/seoul-techno-holdings).

![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/01/%EC%9A%94%EC%96%91%EC%9D%98%EC%A0%95%EC%84%9D-800x398-1.webp)

The investment came just five months after incorporation, marking significant external recognition of Yojeong’s execution capabilities, [AI](http://en.wowtale.net/tag/ai) technology innovation in the senior care market, and authentic service approach.

Yojeong operates a platform connecting families with trusted caregiving information and practical care resources. The company systematically converts fragmented care and nursing information into structured data, delivering personalized services through AI based on specific care situations and family conditions. This approach dramatically reduces the time inefficiencies and financial burdens that family caregivers face throughout the elderly care process.

[![](https://cdn.wowtale.net/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/05/wowtale_meet_founders_72890.png)](https://en.wowtale.net/category/interview/)

Seunghwan Mok, CEO of Seoul Techno Holdings, noted that as Korea’s aging accelerates and the senior tech market enters structural growth, Yojeong demonstrates a deep understanding of complex nursing field challenges combined with the execution power to implement technological solutions. “We decided to invest primarily based on the team’s completeness in problem-solving capabilities, and we expect them to establish operational standards across the senior care industry,” Mok stated.

Minji Cho, CEO of Yojeong, said this investment reflects a shared vision for improving care service quality. “We will advance our platform’s data analysis technology to create ‘standards for nursing care’ that both family caregivers and seniors can trust,” Cho added.
